Hi Alice / FinServ security team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the clear description of your upcoming pilot and the regulatory constraints you're balancing. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Pilot will ingest customer-submitted PII (names, masked SSNs, transaction metadata) for fraud scoring.
- Retention: raw input retained for 30 days; aggregated outputs retained 7 years for audit (legal currently reviewing).
- Residency: production and audit logs must remain in US regions only.
- Controls: you require TLS-in-transit, at-rest encryption, and either customer-managed keys (BYOK/KMS) or an HSM-backed key custody option.

Action items / next steps I propose:
1) Attach a concise comparison (attached: kms-options-matrix.xlsx) with tradeoffs, ops overhead, and SLAs for our hosted BYOK, Dedicated w/ HSM, and Private deployment options.
2) Technical deep-dive to cover: KMS integration patterns, key rotation, audit log sampling/retention, and where we surface telemetry for your auditors. I booked a 60-minute slot placeholder (link below) — please propose alternative times if needed.
3) Marissa (security) and Markus (SE) will draft a one-page runbook that maps your compliance asks (PII retention + log sampling) to configuration and evidence we can provide.

Attachments: kms-options-matrix.xlsx, redwood-byok-hsm-brief.pdf
Related link: https://meetings.hubspot.com/avery-johnson/technical-deep-dive

Would love confirmation on the list above and any additional deliverables you need (SOC2 evidence, KYC for HSM vendor, or encryption performance SLAs).

Hi Alice / FinServ security,

Thanks for the questions — see answers and attachments below. I pulled together a short technical pack and an ops estimate from Markus (attached).

Short answers to your three asks:
1) Key exportability: for Redwood hosted BYOK we support customer-supplied key material via a import-only flow where keys are marked non-exportable by default. We also offer an HSM-backed path (FIPS 140-2 Level 3) for Dedicated/Private where key material is non-exportable and attested by the HSM vendor.

2) Audit evidence we can provide (samples attached):
- Key lifecycle logs (rotate/create/destroy) — streamable to your SIEM or delivered as time-windowed bundles (we can retain 12 months in our audit storage).
- TLS certificate rotation cadence and CA — we maintain TLS certs with quarterly rotation; if you require custom CA or mutual TLS we can support in Dedicated/Private.
- Per-request telemetry: we can provide anonymized per-request telemetry (token count, latency, model id, storage calls) and a masked sample that omits PII; we can also provide a sampling policy to match your audit needs.

3) Ops lift & timeline:
- Hosted BYOK: minimal ops lift; onboarding ~2 weeks once we receive key material and access approvals.
- Dedicated w/ HSM: medium lift; procurement of HSM-backed nodes + key custodian setup ~6–8 weeks.
- Private (on-prem): higher lift; dependent on infra readiness — typical 8–12 weeks.

Attachments included: redwood-byok-hsm-brief.pdf, soc2-type2-report-redwood-2026.pdf, kms-options-matrix.xlsx, SE-estimate-dedicated-private.pdf

Proposed next steps:
- Technical deep-dive (60m): cover BYOK import flows, HSM attestations, log exports (SIEM), and retention policies. Suggested attendees: FinServ Data Protection lead, FinServ infra, Avery, Markus, Marissa.
- If you need the SOC2 signed NDA redaction, let us know and we can redact client-specific references.

Would Monday (2027-04-12) at 10am PT work for the deep-dive? I can send a calendar invite once confirmed.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
